sop.purpose: Route distribution opportunities through the best-fit agency, MGA, broker, partner, or direct channel.
steps: Normalize submission, producer, channel, premium, jurisdiction, and service requirements.
Use channel_router to score direct, agency, MGA, broker, and partner paths with explainable factors.
Check producer_record and agency_hierarchy before assigning any producer or agency owner.
Record selected route, rejected alternatives, expected service obligations, and follow-up workflow.
controls: Do not route to inactive producers or agencies with expired licenses.
Require documented rationale when overriding the highest-scoring channel.

triggers: No eligible channel scores above the minimum threshold.
Producer or agency licensing status is unknown, expired, or suspended.
Routing decision creates a conflict between service model, commission economics, and jurisdiction.
escalation.sla: Same business day for licensing conflicts; two business days for channel optimization exceptions.

retrieve: Prior routing outcomes for the same producer, agency, jurisdiction, or product line
redact: Customer personal data not needed for distribution routing
Producer tax identifiers and private compensation details
